claims.text: The primary objective is ROC-AUC, so changes supported only by F1 or calibration evidence do not establish an improvement in the primary metric.

Semantic features scored 0.0096 above minimal features in a 30% sample pilot, while interaction-heavy features were close to minimal; the pilot results have substantial fold variation.
There is one row per client and all clients cover the same six months, but the evidence does not specify whether production requires generalization to new clients or future time periods.
Threshold moving and class weighting improved F1 relative to no imbalance treatment, but their PR-AUC results were nearly unchanged; no ROC-AUC results for these remedies are provided.
Platt scaling and isotonic calibration have lower mean Brier scores than no calibration; isotonic is lower than Platt by only 0.0004, and no paired significance test is reported.

claims.text: The task is binary classification, and the primary metric is ROC AUC, where higher is better.
The development data contains 11,232 rows and 113 encoded features.
The class shares are imbalanced, with 89.06% in one class and 10.94% in the other.
All reported feature-selection pilots used a 30% sample and 3-fold cross-validation.
The pilot ROC AUC means range from 0.5397 to 0.5576, and the reported fold results vary within each pilot.
The pilot with the highest reported mean ROC AUC was 0.5576 ± 0.0220, based on folds of 0.58299, 0.54385, and 0.54598.

claims.text: The default LightGBM configuration scores 0.5991 ± 0.0134 in 3-fold cross-validation on ROC AUC.
Across eight configurations, the best observed 3-fold CV score is 0.6362, which is 0.0372 above the default score and exceeds the policy’s 0.005 improvement threshold.
The eight search scores vary from 0.57932 to 0.63624, so the observed best score comes from a broad spread of results.
The default CV estimate has a reported standard deviation of 0.0134, indicating variability in the measured baseline score.

claims.text: The task is binary classification, and the primary metric is ROC AUC, with higher values preferred.
The development dataset contains 11,250 rows and 23 encoded features, with no missingness reported on average.
Default LightGBM hyper-parameters achieved a 3-fold CV ROC AUC of 0.7642 ± 0.0011.
Across eight randomly sampled configurations, the best reported 3-fold CV ROC AUC was 0.7755, about 0.0113 above the default result.
The eight sampled configurations had reported CV scores ranging from 0.72759 to 0.77552.

The price-discount pilot confidence interval is entirely below zero, supporting a negative causal effect on the measured outcome in that pilot.
